_note: Testing switches, for trying things out. Turn them all off (false) before a real release. money_amount is what gold and gems are topped back up to; acorns_amount is what your Acorns are topped back up to in Draft Duel (the opponent is not affected). show_dev_tools shows the Developer tools (trophies, gold, time skips...) at the bottom of your Profile in every build, including the website.
